text.p: Supertyphoon Yates will move westward across the central Mariana Islands, near Saipan, during the next 6-12 hours. Top winds will remain near 150 mph, and Yates will produce destruction due to the winds, as well as coastal storm surge and very heavy rain. Yates is expected to continue westward into the waters west of the Mariana Islands in 24 hours. It should then turn towards the north while weakening only slowly. Yates will continue to be a strong risk to shipping through the 72 hour period.

Tropical Storm Zane is in the Philippine Sea near 17n/132e, moving west northwest at 14 mph. Zane is expected to continue this motion while slowing in forward speed during the next 36 hours. Zane has top winds near 55 mph but will likely reach typhoon strength by the end of this forecast period. Zane is mainly a risk to shipping during the next 24 hours. The north Luzon region may come under risk thereafter but this is uncertain.

Tropical storm Isidore is mainly a risk to shipping in the southern Atlantic during the next 72 hours. Maximum sustained winds are currently about 40 mph but they may increase to 65 mph in 72 hours. It is located this morning about 500 miles southwest of the Cape Verde islands.
